quotes.text: Create and manage subscriptions to accept recurring payments.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: This is a Full hosted page for when platform is web and ui is stripe-hosted.
You must use the [Stripe API version 2025-06-30.basil](https://docs.stripe.com/upgrades.md) or later.

The Checkout Sessions API provides built-in support for tax calculation, discounts, shipping, and currency conversion, reducing the amount of custom code you need to write. This is the recommended approach for most integrations.
On the back end, create the subscription with an `incomplete` status using `payment_behavior=default_incomplete`.
